newsitem.title: USA: Group has 5.9 pct stake in Cal Dive.
newsitem.headline: Group has 5.9 pct stake in Cal Dive.

text.p: San Francisco-based Cambridge Investments Ltd said Friday that it has a 5.9 percent stake, or 837,500 common shares, in Cal Dive International Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the investor group said it bought shares in Cal Dive between July 1 and 3 at prices ranging from $15 to $21.18 a share.

Cal Dive had its initial public offering of shares on July 1. The Houston-based company provides such services as deep-sea building, inspection, maintenance, repair and salvage to the offshore natural gas and oil industry in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico.
